checks.disclosures: Privacy section 5 describes tab-local display markers for headline and homepage section, and existing section view restoration. No email matching, subscription API, subscriber promotion targeting or new analytics fields/permissions added. Terms remains consistent with these navigation/display changes.
checks.security: Independent bounded review passed 37 focused tests and diff whitespace check. Captured section/request generations protect catalog metadata; moderation failures keep unknown listings unpublished; owner boundaries protect views; stale analytics digest cannot replace current catalog. Fixed photo paths only. Existing consent, GPC, admin and local exclusions preserved.
